summary: acer nitro 16 gaming system experiencing sudden laggy behavior while using both integrated and dedicated GPUs, with potential conflict between AMD and Nvidia GPUs as suspected root cause.
detected_fault: Potential conflict between AMD integrated GPU and Nvidia GeForce RTX3050 Laptop GPU causing system lag and freeze.
suggested_solution: Update BIOS to latest version and ensure both GPUs are properly configured, or consider using only one GPU for gaming.
